provenance: Telephone call, 2026-09-01. Larry's son asked about a story Larry had told him previously, and reported the answer in his own words. Third-person voice, so this is a paraphrase. Raw capture: research/interviews/2026-09-01-phone-answers.md.
text: In the pictures, there are pictures of the guys from CBC. They were doing a documentary and they asked me some questions. We all ate together. They were there about two weeks filming, don't recall the timeframe when they were there. CBC made a video and my father may be in it but no idea what it was called. I believe it was done in '64 maybe around Christmas time.
researchNotes: Filed as paraphrase because the answer slips into the third person ("my father may be in it"), which this archive treats as the giveaway regardless of where the facts came from. Entirely new: no CBC crew, documentary or film unit appears anywhere else in the archive. Three claims worth testing separately — that a Canadian Broadcasting Corporation crew filmed on site for about two weeks; that Larry was asked questions on camera; and that photographs of the crew are among his own scans. The date is his least certain element ("I believe", "maybe"), and Christmas 1964 would place it early in his tour. Canadian Broadcasting Corporation current-affairs and documentary output of that period is catalogued, so this is traceable in a way most leads are not.
